abstract: This paper examines the impact of credit frictions arising from firm-level default risk on aggregate economic performance. We build a micro-to-macro model with heterogeneous firms and sector-specific production functions, showing that perceived default risk is a sufficient statistic for credit frictions. Using UK administrative data (2004–2019) matched to S&P risk measures, counterfactual estimates reveal that relaxing frictions raises output by 25% and wages by 23%. Ignoring equilibrium wage adjustments overstates output gains, while fixed-capital misallocation approaches understate them. Most gains reflect aggregate capital accumulation. Credit frictions remain above pre-crisis levels, reshape firm size dynamics, increase misallocation across firms, and dampen productivity growth over time.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业层面违约风险引发的信贷摩擦对总体经济表现的影响。我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和部门特定生产函数的微观-宏观模型，表明感知违约风险是信贷摩擦的充分统计量。利用英国行政数据（2004-2019年）与标普风险指标匹配，反事实估计显示，放松信贷摩擦可使产出提高25%，工资提高23%。忽略均衡工资调整会高估产出收益，而固定资本错配方法则会低估产出收益。大部分收益源于总体资本积累。信贷摩擦仍高于危机前水平，重塑了企业规模动态，加剧了企业间的资源错配，并长期抑制了生产率增长。
title: The Equilibrium Impact of Credit Frictions: Evidence from Default Risk Using Firm-Level Data
title_zh: DP21791 信贷摩擦的均衡影响：基于企业层面数据违约风险的证据

abstract: I study the interaction between spiteful preferences and interdependent values in auctions. While spite causes overbidding in both auction formats, interdependent values affect spiteful bidders' incentives differently depending on the auction format. Relative to independent values, bidders with interdependent values are less affected by spite in first‐price auctions, but more affected in second‐price auctions: the decrease in bid shading is smaller in the former, while the increase in above‐value bidding is greater in the latter. This format‐dependent behaviour reflects the trade‐off between increased competitiveness driven by spite and caution induced by the winner's curse.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了拍卖中恶意偏好与相互依存价值的交互作用。尽管恶意行为在两种拍卖形式中均导致过度出价，但相互依存价值对恶意竞拍者激励的影响因拍卖形式而异。相较于独立价值，具有相互依存价值的竞拍者在第一价格拍卖中受恶意影响较小，但在第二价格拍卖中受恶意影响更大：前者中出价折扣的降幅较小，而后者中高于价值出价的增幅较大。这种依赖于拍卖形式的行为，反映了恶意驱动的竞争性增强与赢家诅咒引发的谨慎性之间的权衡。
title: Interdependent‐value auctions with spiteful bidders
title_zh: 恶意竞拍者参与的相互依赖价值拍卖

abstract: We study how the interaction between demographic changes and spatial sorting affects marriage matching across space. Using data from China, we first present stylized facts on the diverging spatial distribution of singlehood characterized by a high singles rate for females (males) in more (less) developed cities. We then build a quantitative spatial equilibrium model. It reveals that more highly educated women sort into the service sector in more developed cities than men. With persistent social norms of hypergamy, this results in more failed marriage matches for females (males) in more (less) developed cities, thereby lowering the national marriage rate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人口结构变化与空间分选之间的相互作用如何影响跨区域的婚姻匹配。利用中国数据，我们首先呈现了单身现象空间分布分化的典型事实：在较发达城市，女性单身率较高；而在欠发达城市，男性单身率较高。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型。模型揭示，相较于男性，更多高学历女性倾向于在较发达城市的服务部门集聚。在持续存在的“上嫁”社会规范下，这导致较发达城市中女性婚姻匹配失败率上升，而欠发达城市中男性婚姻匹配失败率上升，进而降低了全国婚姻率。

abstract: This paper examines the rapid expansion and convergence of retail betting markets. We analyze market design elements, discuss economic utility, and highlight shared behavioral drivers of sports betting markets, prediction markets, and retail options trading. Our review underscores how technological innovation, behavioral biases, and regulatory arbitrage have shaped recent market evolution. We highlight important considerations for policy-makers facing a changing landscape and outline possibilities for further research.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了零售博彩市场的快速扩张与趋同现象。我们分析了市场设计要素，探讨了经济效用，并揭示了体育博彩市场、预测市场与零售期权交易共有的行为驱动因素。本综述强调技术创新、行为偏差与监管套利如何塑造了近期市场演变。我们为面临不断变化格局的政策制定者提出重要考量，并勾勒出未来研究的可能性方向。
title: Retail Betting Markets
title_zh: 零售博彩市场

abstract: We document a robust industry-level distress anomaly in which more distressed industries earn significantly lower expected equity returns. The anomaly is distinct from the firm-level distress anomaly (Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008). It remains significant after controlling for firm-level distress but disappears in placebo industries formed by randomly reshuffling firms across actual industries. Both theoretically and empirically, we show that competition-distress feedback amplifies the exposure of industry profit margins and equity returns to discount-rate shocks. Industries with greater idiosyncratic left-tail risk are more distressed but exhibit weaker competition-distress feedback. This effect reduces their exposure to discount-rate shocks and thus lowers their expected equity returns.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一个稳健的行业层面困境异象，即困境程度更高的行业获得的预期股票收益率显著更低。该异象与公司层面的困境异象（Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008）存在显著差异。在控制公司层面困境后，该异象依然显著，但在通过随机重组实际行业中的公司所形成的虚拟行业中则消失。理论与实证均表明，竞争-困境反馈机制放大了行业利润率与股票收益率对贴现率冲击的暴露程度。具有更大特质性左尾风险的行业困境程度更高，但其竞争-困境反馈效应更弱。这一效应降低了这些行业对贴现率冲击的暴露程度，从而降低了其预期股票收益率。
title: Industry Distress Anomaly
title_zh: 行业困境异象

abstract: A decline in credit scores can worsen the borrower's financial position, making default a self-fulfilling prophecy. We estimate the causal effect of credit scores on default using a rule that counts multiple inquiries within 14 days as one, moving scores without changing credit reports. Regression discontinuity estimates around the 14-day cut-off show that an additional counted inquiry lowers scores by five points on average. Default does not respond among consumers with clean records, but rises by 3.2 percentage points over two years among those with prior derogatories. For these consumers, at least 13 percent of the relationship between scores and default is self-fulfilling. We show that scorers would want to limit self-fulfilling defaults if their objective is forecast accuracy, but not if it is separating defaulters from non-defaulters, because that objective rewards the score for the defaults it causes.
abstract_zh: 信用评分下降可能恶化借款人的财务状况，使违约成为自我实现的预言。我们利用一项规则——将14天内多次查询合并为一次，从而在不改变信用报告的情况下调整评分——来估计信用评分对违约的因果效应。基于14天临界点的断点回归估计显示，每增加一次被计入的查询平均会使评分降低5分。在信用记录良好的消费者中，违约并未出现显著变化；但在有不良记录的消费者中，两年内违约率上升了3.2个百分点。对于这些消费者而言，评分与违约之间至少13%的关系是自我实现的。研究表明，若评分机构的目标是预测准确性，它们会倾向于限制自我实现的违约；但若目标是区分违约者与非违约者，则不会如此，因为后一目标会因评分引发的违约而奖励该评分。
title: Self-Fulfilling Credit Scores
title_zh: 自我实现的信用评分

abstract: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.
abstract_zh: 经济激励可能促进疫苗接种，但其成本效益取决于能否精准锁定最易响应的患者群体。我们在2021-2022年流感季期间，对某整合医疗系统中57,579名成年患者开展随机对照试验。将近期有预约的患者随机分为四组：无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组、最高价值5000美元的刮刮乐彩票激励组。任何主动干预措施均使预约接种率提升2个百分点（较对照组均值增长8%），整个流感季接种率提升1.5个百分点。三个干预组间无显著差异，表明小额经济激励相较于单纯提醒并未产生额外效益。我们利用电子健康档案与区域特征数据，通过因果森林模型估计条件平均处理效应。预测响应度呈现显著异质性：响应度最高四分位患者对激励措施的反应概率是低四分位患者的3-4倍，而提醒效应的异质性相对较小。研究结果表明，低成本提醒可提升流感疫苗接种率，机器学习方法则有助于识别对小额经济激励最敏感的患者群体。
title: Effects of Lottery Incentives for Influenza Vaccination: Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Trial and Causal Forest Analysis
title_zh: 彩票激励对流感疫苗接种的影响：来自大规模随机试验与因果森林分析的证据

abstract: Progressive taxation is central to high-income countries' tax systems, but developing countries typically rely on less progressive instruments. We study the introduction of progressive property taxation in a large Congolese city through a citywide field experiment conducted in partnership with the provincial government. Neighborhoods were randomly assigned to a progressive or a proportional schedule. The progressive schedule increased revenue by 56% relative to the proportional one. Gains occurred throughout the property value distribution: at the top, higher statutory rates mechanically raised revenue despite modest compliance losses; at the bottom, lower rates induced compliance gains large enough to offset lower liabilities. Cross-randomized information treatments show that taxpayers responded primarily to their own rates, not to others' rates or to the perceived fairness of the overall schedule. Effective tax rates – taxes paid as a share of property value – declined with property value and were most regressive under the progressive schedule. However, after a progressive schedule was scaled up citywide in subsequent years, targeted enforcement among high-value properties reversed this pattern, aligning statutory and effective rates. Together, the results suggest that progressive property taxation can raise fiscal capacity in low-income settings and, when paired with targeted enforcement, further shift the tax burden onto wealthier property owners.
abstract_zh: 累进税制是高收入国家税收体系的核心，但发展中国家通常采用累进性较弱的税制。我们与省政府合作，在刚果某大城市开展了一项全市范围的实地实验，研究累进财产税的引入效果。社区被随机分配至累进税率或比例税率方案。相较于比例税率，累进税率使税收收入增加56%。这一增长覆盖了全部房产价值区间：在高端房产中，尽管存在适度的合规损失，但更高的法定税率机械性地提升了收入；在低端房产中，较低的税率带来的合规收益足以抵消税负减少的影响。交叉随机信息干预实验表明，纳税人主要对自身税率做出反应，而非他人税率或整体税制的公平性感知。有效税率（即实际缴纳的税款占房产价值的比例）随房产价值递减，且在累进税制下呈现最强的累退性。然而，当累进税制在后续年份推广至全市范围后，针对高价值房产的定向执法扭转了这一趋势，使法定税率与有效税率趋于一致。综合来看，研究结果表明：累进财产税能够提升低收入地区的财政汲取能力，若配合定向执法，可进一步将税负转移至更富裕的房产所有者。
title: Does Progressivity Raise Tax Capacity? Experimental Evidence from the D.R. Congo
title_zh: 累进性是否提升税收能力？来自刚果（金）的实验证据

abstract: We document arguably unintended returns of biodiversity conservation to science discovery, exploiting the 2002 fishing ban in China—an ecosystem restoration policy without explicit science-related objectives, which allows us to implement a difference-in-differences design across fish species. We find that the ban substantially increased research on affected species: funded programs rose by 21.5%, total funding by 22.8%, publications per program by 97.0%, and citations per paper by 106.7%. The effect is concentrated among researchers with geographic access to the river, and is stronger for non-extinct species and non-farmed fish species, suggesting that conservation expanded the supply of biological materials available for research. The ban also increased related public influence and patents. These results reveal that biodiversity conservation generates a significant scientific dividend through the restoration of natural research inputs, with implications for evaluating the broader benefits of ecosystem protections in an underdiscussed dimension for the science of science.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了生物多样性保护对科学发现的意外回报，利用2002年中国实施的禁渔令——一项没有明确科学相关目标的生态系统恢复政策，这使得我们能够对鱼类物种进行双重差分设计。研究发现，禁渔令显著增加了受影响物种的研究：资助项目数量上升21.5%，总资助金额增加22.8%，每个项目的论文产出提高97.0%，每篇论文的引用量增长106.7%。这一效应集中在具有河流地理接近性的研究人员中，且对非灭绝物种和非养殖鱼类更为显著，表明保护措施扩大了可供研究的生物材料供给。禁渔令还提升了相关的公众影响力及专利数量。这些结果揭示，生物多样性保护通过恢复自然研究投入产生了显著的科学红利，对在科学学中尚未充分讨论的维度上评估生态系统保护的更广泛效益具有启示意义。

title: The Scientific Return of Biodiversity Conservation: Evidence from Fishing Bans Along the Yangtze River
title_zh: 生物多样性保护的科学回报：来自长江禁渔政策的证据

abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms’ value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%–20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%–20% among the highest-net-worth individuals. Accounting for income in holding companies erases half of the difference in the 1980–2020 rise of the top 1% fiscal income share between Nordic countries and the United States, where rules penalizing the use of holding companies have been in place since the 1930s.
abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司避税长期以来被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年来将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由不超过五名所有者持有超过50%股份、且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入前0.1%群体中，约半数收入留存于此类公司。对运营企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司约将半数股息分配从个人所得税中屏蔽。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体二十年累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或享受豁免），财富税无法提供有效补充。因此，包含所有税种在内的实际税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值人群的约15%-20%。若将控股公司收入纳入统计，1980-2020年间北欧国家与美国的顶层1%财政性收入份额增长差异将缩小一半——美国自1930年代起便实施限制控股公司使用的规则。
title: Personal Holding Companies, Tax Progressivity, and Inequality
title_zh: 个人控股公司、税收累进性与不平等

abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of early-life exposure to county health departments (CHDs), a public health initiative aimed at providing affordable healthcare access to disadvantaged and underserved areas during the early decades of the 20th century, on later-life longevity. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census and implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to compare the longevity of individuals exposed at different ages to the county-specific year of CHD establishment. We find that exposure to a CHD opening in the county of birth during fetal development and early years of life is associated with a 1-4-month increase in longevity. We observe considerable heterogeneity in the results, such that the effects are more concentrated among non-white individuals and individuals with lower-educated parents. Contemporaneous fertility and infant mortality data suggest reductions in infant mortality rates and increases in birth rates following CHD openings. Additionally, we find significant improvements in educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and income in early adulthood. We argue that enhancements in the fetal environment, improved fetal survival, and better early life health capital resulting from CHD exposure contribute to improvements in human capital during adulthood, with potential implications for later-life longevity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期接触县级卫生部门（CHDs）对晚年寿命的长期影响。CHDs是20世纪早期旨在为弱势和医疗服务不足地区提供可负担医疗服务的公共卫生举措。我们利用与1940年人口普查相关联的社会保障管理局死亡记录，并采用双重差分估计策略，比较不同年龄接触县级卫生部门设立年份的个体的寿命差异。研究发现，在胎儿发育期和生命早期接触出生县CHD的设立与寿命延长1-4个月相关。结果存在显著异质性，非白人个体及父母教育水平较低的个体受影响更为集中。同期生育率和婴儿死亡率数据显示，CHD设立后婴儿死亡率下降、出生率上升。此外，我们发现早期成年期的教育程度、社会经济地位和收入均有显著改善。我们认为，CHD接触带来的胎儿环境改善、胎儿存活率提升及早期健康资本积累，促进了成年期人力资本提升，并对晚年寿命产生潜在影响。
title: Early Life Healthcare Access and Later-life Mortality: Evidence Using Openings of County Health Departments
title_zh: 早期医疗保健可及性与晚年死亡率：基于县级卫生部门设立的证据

abstract: Total fertility rates in East Asia have fallen to levels without historical precedent, even though the region’s Confucian heritage long placed extraordinary emphasis on family continuity and large families. We argue that this “Confucian Fertility Paradox” dissolves once we separate two strands of the tradition and recognize that modernization affected them very differently. The pro-natal strand, built on lineage continuity, ancestor worship, and reliance on sons for old-age support, was gradually switched off as child mortality fell, incomes rose, women entered the labor force, and state pensions replaced the family as the main source of security in old age. What survived was the second strand: the veneration of education and of status won through examination success, rooted in the imperial examination tradition. Under modern conditions this surviving strand reverses sign with respect to its effect on fertility. Where the historical examination system rewarded having many sons so that one might succeed, the modern single-ranking tournament rewards concentrating resources on one or two intensively educated children, and the quantity–quality tradeoff turns a once pro-natal culture into a powerful engine of low fertility. Drawing on recent empirical evidence from China and Korea, we show how education competition becomes the channel through which traditional values now suppress childbearing. We explain why standard pro-natalist policies, such as removing birth restrictions or offering cash subsidies, accomplish little when the underlying problem is a competitive equilibrium in parental investment, and we argue that policies aimed at the source of the distortion, such as structural reform of educational pathways, hold more promise.
abstract_zh: 东亚地区的总和生育率已降至史无前例的低水平，尽管该地区悠久的儒家传统历来极度重视家族延续与多子多福。本文认为，一旦我们将这一传统中的两条脉络加以区分，并认识到现代化对它们产生了截然不同的影响，所谓的"儒家生育悖论"便迎刃而解。第一条鼓励生育的脉络——建立在宗族延续、祖先崇拜以及养儿防老基础之上——随着儿童死亡率下降、收入增长、女性进入劳动力市场以及国家养老金取代家庭成为老年保障的主要来源而逐渐消退。留存下来的是第二条脉络：对教育的尊崇以及通过科举成功获得社会地位的追求，这一传统根植于帝国科举制度。在现代条件下，这条留存下来的脉络对生育的影响发生了逆转。历史上的科举制度奖励多生儿子以增加中举概率，而现代单一排名的锦标赛式竞争则鼓励将资源集中投入于一两个接受精英教育的子女身上。数量与质量的权衡使曾经鼓励生育的文化转变为低生育率的强大引擎。基于来自中国和韩国的最新实证证据，我们揭示了教育竞争如何成为传统价值观抑制生育的传导渠道。我们解释了为何当根本问题在于父母投资中的竞争均衡时，诸如取消生育限制或提供现金补贴等标准鼓励生育政策收效甚微，并论证了针对扭曲根源的政策——例如教育路径的结构性改革——更具前景。

title: The Confucian Fertility Paradox: Education Competition and Ultra-Low Fertility in East Asia
title_zh: 儒家生育悖论：教育竞争与东亚超低生育率

abstract: This paper examines reforms in China’s imperial examination system during the Northern Song dynasty that anonymized exam submissions and ended local officials’ discretion to recommend candidates. Using prefecture-level data from 960–1127 and a difference-in-differences design, we compare areas with and without prominent elite families, where corruption and elite capture were more likely. The reforms increased the share of successful candidates from commoner backgrounds and narrowed their performance gaps with elites in scholarship and political achievement, indicating better selection of commoner talent. Treated prefectures also saw less social unrest. Overall, the reforms strengthened meritocracy, broadened political access, and promoted stability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了北宋时期科举制度的改革，该改革对考卷进行匿名处理，并终止了地方官员推荐考生的自由裁量权。利用960年至1127年的府级数据，并采用双重差分法，我们比较了存在显著精英家族的地区（这些地区更易发生腐败和精英俘获）与其他地区的情况。改革提高了来自平民背景的考生中举比例，并缩小了他们与精英阶层在学术造诣和政治成就上的表现差距，表明对平民人才的选拔更为有效。受改革影响的府级地区社会动荡也有所减少。总体而言，改革强化了贤能政治，拓宽了政治参与渠道，并促进了社会稳定。

title: Elite Capture, Meritocracy and Social Stability: Evidence from the Chinese Imperial Examinations
title_zh: 精英俘获、精英统治与社会稳定：来自中国科举制度的证据

abstract: As renewable generation plays a growing role in the energy system, periods of negative wholesale electricity prices are becoming increasingly common and are expected to grow dramatically over the next ten years. Traditionally, system operators respond by paying generators, especially renewables, to curtail production, or mandating that they do so without compensation. In this study, we propose and test a novel alternative: exposing consumers to free and negative prices to stimulate demand when supply is abundant. We implemented large-scale nationwide natural field experiments simultaneously in Great Britain and Spain, with roughly 60,000 residential customers in each country randomized to receive varying financial incentives to “turn up” their electricity. We found that demand increased substantially as prices fell to zero, but paying customers to consume beyond zero price yielded little additional response. Households with electric vehicles and rooftop solar had a larger elasticity than households without such technologies, suggesting demand turn-up becomes more effective as households adopt low-carbon technologies. In Great Britain, consumption was largely shifted from adjacent hours, while in Spain the increase appeared to represent net new demand. We develop a welfare framework showing conditions under which demand turn-up improves on curtailment; we find that by inducing additional consumption in periods and locations where the marginal cost of supply is low, demand turn-up generates welfare gains that curtailment leaves uncaptured.
abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源在能源系统中扮演日益重要的角色，负批发电价现象正变得愈发普遍，预计未来十年将大幅增长。传统上，系统运营商会通过向发电商（尤其是可再生能源发电商）支付费用要求其削减产量，或强制其无偿减产来应对这一情况。本研究提出并检验了一种创新替代方案：在供应充裕时，通过向消费者提供零电价甚至负电价来刺激需求。我们在英国和西班牙同步开展了大规模全国性自然现场实验，每个国家约有6万户居民被随机分配接受不同力度的经济激励，以"提升"其用电量。研究发现，当电价降至零时，需求显著增长；但通过付费激励消费者在零电价基础上进一步增加用电，收效甚微。拥有电动汽车和屋顶太阳能的家庭需求弹性显著高于未配备此类技术的家庭，这表明随着家庭采用低碳技术，"需求提升"策略将更为有效。在英国，用电增量主要来自相邻时段的用电转移；而在西班牙，用电增长则表现为净新增需求。我们构建了一个福利分析框架，揭示了"需求提升"优于"削减产量"的条件：通过在供应边际成本较低的时段和区域诱导额外消费，"需求提升"能够产生"削减产量"策略无法实现的福利增益。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为英国和西班牙的居民电力消费，数据、制度背景均非中国
title: A Demand-Side Alternative to Renewable Curtailment: Natural Field Experimental Evidence from Two Countries
title_zh: 可再生能源弃电的需求侧替代方案：来自两国的自然实地实验证据

abstract: We study how temperature fluctuations affect U.S. state-level economic conditions using high frequency, weekly data from 1987 to 2024. The impulse response to a temperature shock from a panel local projection framework reveals a modest short-run increase in economic conditions followed by a delayed and persistent medium-run decline. Nonlinearities show that the medium-run decline is larger and more persistent at higher base temperatures. A decomposition of the economic conditions index points to the labor market as the primary channel. To interpret these findings, we develop a weekly labor search and matching model featuring a labor disutility channel, a heat damage stock, and a slow-moving adaptation mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1987年至2024年的高频周度数据，研究温度波动如何影响美国各州经济状况。基于面板局部投影框架的温度冲击脉冲响应显示，经济状况在短期内温和上升，随后出现延迟且持续的中期下降。非线性分析表明，在较高基准温度下，中期下降幅度更大且更持久。对经济状况指数的分解表明，劳动力市场是主要传导渠道。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个包含劳动负效用渠道、热损害存量以及缓慢调整适应机制的周度劳动力搜索与匹配模型。
title: Temperature Fluctuations and Economic Conditions: Evidence from Weekly U.S. Data
title_zh: 温度波动与经济状况：来自美国周度数据的证据

abstract: Using mandatory Outlook reports from Chinese mutual funds, we decompose each fund’s equity-market beliefs into macro fundamentals, government policy, and residual sentiment. Policy beliefs, rather than macro beliefs, predict subsequent market returns and help explain the positive alphas observed in China’s mutual fund industry. By contrast, residual sentiment strongly shapes equity allocations and attracts investor flows, even though it does not predict returns. Using maturing wealth management products as an instrument for future aggregate fund flows, we show that funds strategically position their stated beliefs to cater to investors. Overall, our analysis reveals a core tension in active asset management: skilled managers generate performance through policy insights while attracting flows through sentiment alignment.
abstract_zh: 利用中国共同基金的强制性Outlook报告，我们将每只基金的股票市场信念分解为宏观基本面、政府政策和残余情绪。政策信念（而非宏观信念）能够预测后续市场回报，并有助于解释中国共同基金行业观察到的正Alpha。相比之下，残余情绪虽无法预测回报，却显著影响股票配置并吸引投资者资金流入。以即将到期的理财产品作为未来基金总资金流的工具变量，我们发现基金会策略性地调整其陈述的信念以迎合投资者。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了主动资产管理中的核心矛盾：具备技能的基金经理通过政策洞察创造业绩，却需通过情绪迎合来吸引资金流入。

title: Beliefs That Predict Returns and Beliefs That Attract Flows: Policy Insights and Sentiment Catering in Mutual Funds
title_zh: 预测回报的信念与吸引资金的信念：共同基金中的政策洞察与情绪迎合

abstract: This paper examines how networks formed through college athletics influence the early-career trajectories of Ivy League graduates. Tracking professional histories of 120,306 Ivy League graduates, we compare each graduate's actual first job against other potential jobs that the graduate could reasonably have taken. Athletics-based networks, especially team-based connections, materially influence initial job choice. Employing one additional alum from a specific Ivy League collegiate sports team increases the probability that a same-team athlete joins the firm by 193.70% relative to the baseline match probability. Likewise, employing one more Ivy League alum who played a specific Varsity sport increases the probability that any Ivy League athlete who plays the same sport joins the firm by 16.40%, while employing one more alum who played any sport at a specific Ivy League university raises the probability that any Ivy League athlete from the same university joins the firm by 4.60%. For team-based connections, these effects persist whether the alum and the college athlete were direct peers whose college years overlapped or older “network” affiliates whose college years were completely disjoint. Our results demonstrate that college athletics-based social networks materially influence initial job placement and early-career trajectories for top college graduates. More generally, they clarify how non-academic social capital shapes the job searching and matching process within labor markets.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了通过大学体育形成的社交网络如何影响常春藤盟校毕业生的早期职业轨迹。通过追踪120,306名常春藤盟校毕业生的职业历程，我们将每位毕业生的实际首份工作与其可能合理获得的其他潜在工作进行了比较。基于体育运动的社交网络，尤其是团队型联系，对初始职业选择产生了实质性影响。在特定常春藤盟校运动队中每多雇佣一名校友，会使同队运动员加入该企业的概率较基准匹配概率提高193.70%。同样，每多雇佣一名参与过特定校队运动的常春藤盟校校友，会使从事相同运动的任何常春藤盟校运动员加入该企业的概率提高16.40%；而每多雇佣一名在特定常春藤盟校参与过任何运动的校友，会使来自同一大学的任何常春藤盟校运动员加入该企业的概率提高4.60%。对于团队型联系而言，无论校友与大学运动员是大学时期重叠的直接同窗，还是大学时期完全错位的年长"网络"关联者，这种效应均持续存在。我们的研究结果表明，基于大学体育的社交网络对顶尖大学毕业生的初始职业选择和早期职业轨迹具有实质性影响。更广泛而言，这些发现阐明了非学术性社会资本如何在劳动力市场中塑造求职与匹配过程。
title: From Field to Firm: College Sports and Early-Stage Career Choice
title_zh: 从赛场到职场：大学体育与早期职业选择

abstract: Using rich data on Chinese schoolchildren, we study the relationships of IQ and personality traits with children’s risk preferences and how they affect the precision with which those preferences are measured. Our structural model separates preferences from deliberation noise and guessing, and relates guessing to deliberation noise. Psychological measures have weak direct influences on preferences but strongly affect deliberation noise and guessing behavior. Shocks to choice have persistent individual-specific components and are not independent. Socioeconomic background has little direct influence on preferences or deliberation noise once traits are accounted for. Background variables affect psychological traits, however. Risk preferences differ across and within genders. For small gambles, girls are less risk averse than boys, but the opposite holds for larger gambles.
abstract_zh: 基于中国学龄儿童的丰富数据，本研究探讨了智商与人格特质与儿童风险偏好之间的关系，以及这些因素如何影响风险偏好测量的精确度。我们的结构模型将偏好与决策噪声及猜测行为区分开来，并将猜测行为与决策噪声相关联。心理测量指标对偏好的直接影响较弱，但显著影响决策噪声与猜测行为。选择中的冲击具有持久的个体特异性成分，且并非相互独立。在控制心理特质后，社会经济背景对偏好或决策噪声的直接作用微乎其微。然而，背景变量会影响心理特质。风险偏好存在性别间及性别内的差异。对于小额赌博，女孩的风险厌恶程度低于男孩；但对于大额赌博，情况则相反。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为中国学龄儿童，数据来自中国，核心分析基于中国样本。
title: Relating Cognitive Skills and Personality Traits to Economic Preferences: Decision-Making under Cognitive Shocks and Guessing
title_zh: 认知技能与人格特质对经济偏好的影响：认知冲击与猜测情境下的决策行为

abstract: We investigate whether, by providing better and more timely information, the first mandatory online reporting and auditing program for wastewater discharge releases in the U.S. improved facility compliance and environmental performance, while also allowing state regulators to more effectively monitor and enforce regulations. Examining reporting programs with automated feedback features can also offer insights into the potential for artificial intelligence-based tools to improve compliance and environmental performance. Difference-in-difference results suggest that the program resulted in significant increases in the completeness of reporting and reductions in discharges but also greater reported violations. We find that effects are larger for minor dischargers and publicly owned facilities. We also find evidence consistent with the more efficient targeting of inspections by state authorities towards plants with a history of recent noncompliance, which could be a potential mechanism driving these results.
abstract_zh: 本文探究美国首个针对废水排放的强制性在线报告与审计制度，是否通过提供更优质、更及时的信息，提升了设施合规性与环境绩效，同时使州监管机构能够更有效地监督和执行法规。研究具有自动反馈功能的报告制度，也可为基于人工智能的工具在改善合规性与环境绩效方面的潜力提供启示。双重差分结果表明，该制度显著提高了报告的完整性，减少了污染物排放量，但同时也增加了报告的违规事件。我们发现，对小型排放者及公有设施的影响更为显著。此外，证据表明州监管机构更高效地将检查资源集中于近期存在违规历史的工厂，这可能是驱动上述结果的潜在机制。
title: Evidence of How Electronic Reporting and Automated Auditing Affects Regulatory Compliance and Environmental Performance
title_zh: 电子报告与自动审计对监管合规及环境绩效影响的实证证据

abstract: Most unemployment insurance (UI) systems condition the potential duration of benefits on claimants' work history, yet little evidence exists on whether doing so is socially optimal. We study this question using 25 regression discontinuities in Canada's UI system, where benefit duration increases discretely when prior hours worked crosses various thresholds. Using administrative records covering the universe of UI claims from 1997 to 2018, we estimate the fiscal effects of extending potential duration across the work-history distribution. On average, an additional week lengthens unemployment by 0.30 weeks and costs the government $96. However, this average effect masks significant heterogeneity: the mechanical cost falls steeply with prior hours, while the behavioral cost increases modestly. Consequently, the fiscal externality of extending UI rises with labor market attachment. Embedding these estimates in a sufficient statistics framework, we find that the fiscal externality of a uniform extension is 76% larger than that of an extension targeted at claimants with short histories. Moreover, aggregate welfare can be raised at zero fiscal cost by redistributing benefits from high to low hour claimants.
abstract_zh: 大多数失业保险（UI）制度将福利的潜在领取期限与申请人的工作历史挂钩，但关于这种做法是否具有社会最优性的证据却很少。我们利用加拿大失业保险制度中的25个断点回归设计来研究这一问题——在该制度中，当申请人此前的工作时长跨越不同阈值时，福利领取期限会呈阶梯式增加。基于覆盖1997年至2018年所有失业保险申请的行政记录，我们估算了在工作历史分布的不同节点延长潜在领取期限的财政效应。平均而言，每延长一周福利期限会使失业期延长0.30周，并给政府带来96美元的成本。然而，这一平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性：机械性成本随此前工作时长的增加而急剧下降，而行为性成本则温和上升。因此，延长失业保险的财政外部性随劳动力市场依附程度的增强而增大。将这些估计值嵌入充分统计量框架后，我们发现：统一延长福利期限的财政外部性比针对短期工作历史申请人的定向延长高出76%。此外，通过将福利从高工时申请人重新分配给低工时申请人，可以在零财政成本下提高总体社会福利。
title: The Welfare Effects of Conditioning the Potential Duration of UI Benefits on Prior Work History
title_zh: 将失业保险金潜在领取时长与先前工作经历挂钩的福利效应

abstract: OECD countries experienced declining native population growth and rising net immigration over 1990-2024. We compile a new dataset of net immigration rates to OECD countries from all origins and show that most of the increase came from non-OECD countries and was predominantly high-skilled. Push factors, network effects, and policy indices explain little of the large cross-country heterogeneity in immigration dynamics; unexpected shocks and surges were common. Using local projections and several sources of identifying variation, we then estimate the relationship between immigration and growth in GDP per capita, labor productivity, capital investment, and total factor productivity (TFP). Immigration from non-OECD countries was a significant predictor of GDP per worker growth, primarily through higher investment. High-skilled immigration, in particular, was associated with stronger human capital accumulation, faster TFP growth, and greater capital deepening. Native population growth, by contrast, had no or weakly negative effects on GDP per capita and productivity. These results are consistent with a large literature documenting the positive productivity and growth effects of immigration, especially high-skilled immigration.
abstract_zh: 1990-2024年间，OECD国家经历了本土人口增长放缓与净移民持续上升的双重趋势。我们构建了涵盖所有来源国对OECD国家净移民率的新数据集，发现移民增长主要来自非OECD国家，且以高技能移民为主。推力因素、网络效应和政策指数难以解释各国移民动态的巨大异质性，突发性冲击与激增现象普遍存在。通过局部投影法结合多种识别变异来源，我们估算了移民与人均GDP、劳动生产率、资本投资及全要素生产率（TFP）增长之间的关系。非OECD国家移民对人均GDP增长具有显著预测作用，主要通过促进投资实现。高技能移民尤其与更强的人力资本积累、更快的TFP增长及更深的资本深化相关联。相比之下，本土人口增长对人均GDP和生产率无显著影响甚至呈现微弱负效应。这些结论与大量文献中关于移民（特别是高技能移民）对生产率和经济增长具有积极效应的研究结果一致。
title: Immigration and Macroeconomic Outcomes in OECD Countries
title_zh: OECD国家移民与宏观经济结果

abstract: The canonical approach to corporate governance posits a tradeoff between maximizing shareholder profits and maximizing other aspects of shareholder welfare such as social impact. Advances in machine learning that enhance the firm's ability to target specific customers may exacerbate or ameliorate this tradeoff. We estimate these tradeoffs using data from randomized microcredit approvals in South Africa, the Philippines, and Bosnia. We examine social impact on two dimensions: credit access (i.e., reaching disadvantaged groups that typically have less access to financial markets) and impact (i.e., treatment effects on household income). Two of the three lenders could have increased average loan profit margin by 7–9 percentage points through machine learning-based targeting. However, such targeting pushes against social impact goals vis-à-vis credit access; specifically, women and lower-income households would have been more excluded (the implied impact on borrowers' income, also central to the dual goal of social impact, is too imprecisely estimated to draw an inference). To gauge the magnitude of the first tradeoff, we examine how profits would change if the lenders altered whom they lent to within each quintile of baseline borrower income, thus holding the distribution broadly similar but fine-tuning the targeting within income bands. Such a constraint would lower the profit gains of targeting by about half. These findings highlight the importance of quantifying tradeoffs and complementarities when deciding what to maximize.
abstract_zh: 公司治理的经典理论认为，股东利润最大化与股东福利（如社会影响）最大化之间存在权衡。机器学习技术的进步增强了企业精准定位特定客户的能力，这可能加剧或缓解这一权衡。我们利用南非、菲律宾和波斯尼亚随机小额信贷审批数据，从两个维度评估社会影响：信贷可及性（即覆盖通常难以进入金融市场的弱势群体）和实际影响（即对家庭收入的处理效应）。三家贷款机构中有两家可通过基于机器学习的精准定位将平均贷款利润率提高7-9个百分点。然而，这种精准定位会与信贷可及性方面的社会目标产生冲突：具体而言，女性和低收入家庭将被更严重地排斥在外（对借款人收入的影响——这一社会影响双重目标的核心要素——因估计精度不足而无法得出明确结论）。为衡量第一种权衡的规模，我们考察了若贷款机构在基准借款人收入的每个五分位区间内调整放贷对象（即保持收入分布大致相似但优化收入区间内的精准定位），利润将如何变化。这种约束会使精准定位带来的利润增益降低约一半。这些发现凸显了在决策最大化目标时量化权衡与互补关系的重要性。
title: Profits and Social Impacts: Complements vs. Tradeoffs for Lenders in Three Countries
title_zh: 利润与社会影响：三国贷款机构中的互补与权衡

abstract: We develop a new measure of impact elasticity: the change in a firm's environmental impact due to a change in its cost of capital. We find that reducing green firms' financing costs leads to minimal impact changes, while increasing brown firms' financing costs causes significant negative impact changes. Thus, sustainable investing strategies that shift capital from brown to green firms contain a counterproductive channel that makes brown firms more brown without making green firms more green. A mistaken focus on percentage reductions in emissions rewards already-green firms for trivial reductions in emissions and gives brown firms weak incentives to improve.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个新的影响弹性指标：企业资本成本变动所引发的环境影响变化。研究发现，降低绿色企业的融资成本仅带来微乎其微的影响变化，而提高棕色企业的融资成本则会导致显著的影响负向变动。因此，将资本从棕色企业转向绿色企业的可持续投资策略存在适得其反的传导机制——既未能使绿色企业更绿，反而导致棕色企业更棕。若错误地聚焦于排放量的百分比削减，不仅会奖励已实现绿色化的企业进行微不足道的减排，还会削弱棕色企业的改进动力。
title: Counterproductive Sustainable Investing: The Impact Elasticity of Brown and Green Firms
title_zh: 适得其反的可持续投资：棕色企业与绿色企业的影响弹性

abstract: Firms have begun granting passive equity stakes to the government that regulates them. The received reading is “skin in the game:” ownership moves profits onto the treasury's balance sheet, so policy softens. We show that once the price of the stake and the firm's policy exposure are determined in equilibrium, the owners' consent reveals nothing about whether they benefit. Sellers capitalise the induced policy improvement into the price, so an anticipated purchase can only occur at a discount; a government with bargaining power pays zero for a sufficiently exposed firm; and a government that can first raise exposure manufactures precisely enough of it to drive the negotiated price to its legal floor. Equity becomes tribute. Prohibition is nonetheless dominated: at fixed exposure, a passive stake corrects the political underweighting of shareholders. Welfare is maximised by priced permission—an ownership cap at the fixed-exposure optimum and a per-unit price floor equal to baseline no-stake value. The floor, unlike the cap, requires no knowledge of the government's political weights.
title: Equity as Tribute: The Market for Passive State Equity
title_zh: 被动国家股权的市场：作为贡品的股权

abstract: This paper provides the first causal estimates of the global social returns to U.S. public R&D. We use a narrative identification strategy to quantify the effects of exogenous shocks to U.S. R&D appropriations on the dynamic TFP response of 69 foreign economies from 1980–2019. A U.S. R&D appropriations shock equal to 1 percent of the federal R&D capital stock raises foreign TFP by approximately 1 percent after 12 years. This response is driven primarily by nondefense rather than defense R&D and is concentrated in non-OECD economies. These patterns are most consistent with diffusion occurring through openly accessible scientific content, capital-embodied trade, and technological leapfrogging by economies further from the global frontier. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the global social returns to U.S. public nondefense R&D are roughly twice as large as the domestic returns, meaning the U.S. captures about half of these productivity benefits.
title: The Effects of U.S. Public R&D on Global Growth
title_zh: 美国公共研发对全球增长的影响

abstract: How does information disclosure reshape the allocation of environmental risk in the housing market? We quantify the price and distributional impact of the nationwide disclosure of property-level flood risk from First Street on U.S. housing platforms. Using a difference-in-RD design that exploits discrete cutoffs in the disclosed risk categories, we find that homes labeled as "extreme'' flood risk experience a 3.3% price discount and stay on the market for a week longer, relative to those labeled as "severe'' risk. These effects are strongest for coastal properties and remain pervasive across different FEMA floodplain designations. Disclosure also generates significant household resorting: buyers of extreme-risk homes have 5.3% lower income, are more likely to use FHA financing, and are older. Through a discrete choice model, we find that the redistribution of risk to lower-income households is primarily driven by price changes rather than heterogeneous preferences for flood risk.
title: The Price and Distributional Impact of Flood Risk Disclosure: Evidence from US Housing Platforms
title_zh: 洪水风险披露的价格与分配效应：来自美国住房平台的证据

abstract: Research on strategic factor markets has largely treated the terms of exchange as price. We argue that many strategic transactions instead divide value through contractual bundles in which payment terms and control rights are interdependent. In university technology licensing, we theorize Rights Trading: contingent payment, future improvement claims, and commercialization scope operate as linked components of the contractual bundle through which surplus is allocated. Using 858 hand coded university–industry licenses, we find that contracts relying more heavily on royalty and milestone provisions grant licensees stronger future improvement claims and broader commercialization scope. The results persist across controls and fixed effects and are directionally consistent with complementary instrumental-variable, event-study, and selection-bound analyses. We further show that this relationship is stronger when university technology transfer offices have greater contracting experience, suggesting that contracting capability shapes value appropriation in strategic factor markets. More broadly, the study shows that value appropriation in strategic factor markets depends not only on what organizations pay for strategic resources, but also on how contracts allocate control over their future development and commercialization.
title: Beyond Price: Rights Trading in Strategic Factor Markets
title_zh: 超越价格：战略要素市场中的权利交易

abstract: We provide new estimates of the effects of universal child care on the long-term labor outcomes of mothers, documenting the life-cycle impact of Quebec’s universal, subsidized child care program on maternal labor supply, earnings, social program benefit receipt and tax remittances. We find an enduring positive impact on mothers’ employment long after children have aged out of the preschool years. There is also a long-run impact on earnings which grows to be twice as large as the participation effect. This arises because of growth in the intensity of labor force participation and a rise in hourly wages over time, suggesting that initial investments in work have multiplier effects later in women’s careers. There is clear evidence of occupational upgrading but most of the growth is within occupation, including the impact of more labor market experience in the years after children are out of child care. We show that, as a result, tax remittances grow over the lifecycle, and social assistance and employment insurance receipts fall. Our estimate of the fiscal balance of these effects reveals that the net present value of the flow of fiscal benefits may recapture between 75 and 117 percent of the upfront costs of the program.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于普及型儿童保育对母亲长期劳动成果影响的新估计，记录了魁北克省普及型、补贴性儿童保育项目对母亲劳动力供给、收入、社会福利项目领取及税收缴纳的整个生命周期影响。研究发现，即使在子女度过学龄前阶段多年后，该项目对母亲就业仍存在持久的积极影响。此外，对收入的长期影响规模达到参与效应的两倍。这一现象源于劳动力参与强度的增长以及小时工资随时间推移的提升，表明早期工作投入在女性职业生涯后期产生了乘数效应。有明确证据显示职业晋升现象，但大部分增长发生在职业内部，包括子女脱离保育后多年积累的劳动力市场经验的影响。我们证明，由此产生的税收缴纳在整个生命周期中持续增长，而社会救助和失业保险领取金额则下降。基于这些效应的财政平衡估算表明，财政收益流的净现值可能回收该项目前期成本的75%至117%。
title: Investing in Mothers? The Long-Run Impact of a Universal Child Care Program on Maternal Work and Income
title_zh: 投资于母亲？一项普及儿童保育计划对母亲工作与收入的长期影响

abstract: Economic sanctions on oil-producing autocracies change not only the quantity of oil but also how it is produced. Combining field-level production data with satellite measurements of gas flaring and atmospheric methane across six Latin American countries from 2012 to 2024, we study the U.S. sanctions on Venezuela. Per-barrel gas flaring in Venezuela rose about two-and-a-half-fold even as production fell by two-thirds, a pattern no unsanctioned neighbor shows, so environmental damage under sanctions is about two and a half times what a proportional decline in output would predict. Three channels generate this gap: the exit of small, dirty fields (composition) is more than offset by surviving fields running their infrastructure past design capacity (strain) and cutting their operating budgets (maintenance). We identify strain from the response of satellite-measured methane to the world price of naphtha, the imported diluent Venezuela's extra-heavy crude requires, and maintenance from a November 2022 U.S. Treasury license that allowed only Chevron to resume operations at its Venezuelan fields. A similar pattern of rising per-barrel emissions despite falling output appears under the sanctions on Iran (after 2018).
title: The Environmental Costs of Sanctions: Flaring and Venting in Venezuela
title_zh: 制裁的环境成本：委内瑞拉的天然气燃烧与排放

abstract: The current euro area policy framework conflates short-run stabilization with long-run fiscal sustainability, exposing members to deflationary and inflationary tail risks. We employ an estimated euro area model to analyze an alternative framework that separates these objectives. A centralized Treasury issues Eurobonds to finance countercyclical stabilization, while national governments retain responsibility for long-term fiscal sustainability. The Treasury can coordinate with the monetary authority in case of a large recession, with no need to suspend fiscal rules at the national level. The arrangement functions as an automatic stabilizer, eliminating the tail risks of deflation and fiscal stagflation.
title: Who is Afraid of Eurobonds?
title_zh: 谁害怕欧元债券？

abstract: We conducted a survey experiment with over 8,000 participants in Germany, Hungary, and Italy to examine how information about the economic impact of immigration affects the support for more open immigration policies. Respondents who received projections showing higher future incomes under more open immigration policies reported greater support for these policies. The treatment also partly changed how prior attitudes affected policy preferences. Structural estimates suggest that majority support for immigration above current levels would require annual per-capita income gains of about 1.2% in Italy and 1.7% in Germany, and still larger or unattainable gains in Hungary. These increases are large relative to recent historical growth rates, suggesting that economic benefits alone are unlikely to generate vast support for more open immigration policies.
title: Trading Off Openness: Economic Information and Immigration Policy Preferences
title_zh: 权衡开放：经济信息与移民政策偏好

abstract: Debt sustainability analysis typically focuses on debt stocks and the interest rate-growth rate differential, but these are not perfect predictors of fiscal stress. This column argues that debt-service costs are key to understanding when fiscal adjustments become necessary. Using long-run historical evidence, it shows that primary surpluses are more closely associated with debt-service costs than with debt ratios, and that fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate. Overall, debt-service costs represent the immediate claim of public debt on government resources and therefore provide a more direct measure of fiscal pressure than debt ratios alone.
abstract_zh: 债务可持续性分析通常关注债务存量及利率与增长率之差，但这些指标并非财政压力的完美预测因子。本文认为，偿债成本是理解何时需要进行财政调整的关键。基于长期历史证据表明，基本盈余与偿债成本的关联性高于与债务比率的关联性，且当融资条件恶化时，财政应对措施会显著加强。总体而言，偿债成本代表了公共债务对政府资源的即时索取权，因此相较于单纯的债务比率，它能更直接地衡量财政压力。
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Maxime Menuet, Gregory Donnat
title: Debt service and fiscal sustainability
title_zh: 债务服务与财政可持续性

abstract: This paper examines the limitations of spot markets in providing adequate investment incentives to support zero-carbon investments in electricity markets. In contrast, properly designed long-term contracts have the potential to mitigate price volatility and facilitate the funding of the investments. A theoretical model is developed to analyze contract design under conditions of moral hazard and adverse selection, emphasizing the trade-offs that arise when exposing firms to price and quantity risk. The findings inform optimal contract design for nuclear and renewable energy projects, offering policy recommendations to enhance investment incentives while minimizing productive inefficiencies and excessive rents.
title: Designing Contracts for the Energy Transition

abstract: we examine how SDB can distort treatment effects in experiments and discuss mitigation strategies. Translation created by Artificial Intelligence (LLM) #### Share Twitter Facebook LinkedIn is a pervasive threat to the validity of survey and experimental data. Respondents might often misreport sensitive attitudes and behaviors to appear more socially acceptable. We begin by synthesizing empirical evidence on the prevalence and magnitude of SDB across various domains, focusing on studies with individual-level benchmarks. We then critically assess commonly used strategies to mitigate SDB, highlighting how they can sometimes fail by creating confusion or inadvertently increasing perceived sensitivity. To help researchers navigate these challenges, we offer practical guidance on selecting the most suitable tools for different research contexts. Finally, we examine how SDB can distort treatment effects in experiments and discuss mitigation strategies.
title: The Social Desirability Atlas
title_zh: 社会期望图谱

abstract: We examine the effects of a criminal record on labor market outcomes and the mediating role of job sorting using Swedish register data. Prime-age adults with criminal records earn about 30% less than observably similar adults without records and are concentrated in specific employers and occupations. To estimate the causal effect of a criminal record, we use an event study design that compares outcomes for adults charged with an offense for the first time to matched adults who were suspected of a similar offense but not charged. Acquiring a criminal record reduces months employed by 2% and annual earnings by 5%. These negative effects are: twice as large for more serious or subsequent charges, not driven by job displacement or incapacitation, and not mitigated by automatic record expungement, which typically occurs 5 or 10 years after case disposition. We classify firms by their propensity to hire workers with criminal records, holding suspected offense history fixed. A criminal record reduces employment at firms classified as less likely to hire workers with criminal records, increases employment at other firms, and decreases monthly wages across all firm types. Firm propensity to hire workers with criminal records varies substantially — even within industries — and is linked to firm size and managers’ prior exposure to people with records. Leveraging manager moves across small firms, we find that when a firm hires a new manager with greater prior exposure to people with criminal records, it hires more people with records, with no detectable effect on productivity.
title: Job Sorting and the Labor Market Effects of a Criminal Record
title_zh: 犯罪记录的职业分类与劳动力市场效应

abstract: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic life-cycle model to quantify why households save and work. The model incorporates multiple sources of risk—health, marital status, wages, medical expenses, and mortality—as well as endogenous labor supply and human capital accumulation, retirement, and bequest motives at the death of the first and last household member. We estimate it using PSID and HRS data for the 1941–1945 cohort via the Method of Simulated Moments. Eliminating bequest motives reduces aggregate wealth by 23.8% and labor earnings by 1.2%; removing medical expenses lowers them by 13.1% and 0.7%. Wage risk is crucial for early-life saving: its removal reduces wealth by 10.4% but raises earnings by 2.3%. Eliminating marriage and divorce dynamics leads couples—numerous and wealthier—to save and work slightly less, and singles—fewer and poorer—to save and work considerably more. These effects largely offset in the aggregate. Removing all saving motives beyond retirement needs and lifespan uncertainty lowers wealth by 56.9% and earnings by 2.7%. These findings show that capturing multiple risks and behavioral margins jointly is essential to understanding household saving and labor supply.
title: Why Do Households Save and Work?
title_zh: 家庭为何储蓄与工作？

abstract: this paper, we build a general equilibrium model that takes the institutional details of the foreign exchange market into account and allows for deviations from full information rational expectations (FIRE) in a way consistent with forecast survey data and traders’ asset positions. We show that the testable implications of this model — related to foreign exchange derivatives positions, and both realized and expected exchange rates — are strongly supported in the data. Moreover, we argue that the particular form of deviation from FIRE implied by the data can help resolve important exchange rate puzzles, such as the Fama puzzle and the delayed overshooting puzzle, and can generate hump-shaped dynamics of exchange rates.
title: Individual Beliefs, Demand for Currency, and Exchange Rate Dynamics
title_zh: 个体信念、货币需求与汇率动态
